What a selection holds, before reading it

Source: R/summary.R
soil_summary.Rd

Counts the features, horizons and observations of a selection, the variables it holds and what they mean, without transferring the data (POST /query/summary, canonical = true). The counts are those the reads return for the same selection: feature_count is the number of features of soil_features() (layer and components do not apply to it), horizon_count the rows of the wide layout of soil_observations(), observation_count the rows of its long layout. It is also the sizing step before an export: a selection above the limit of synchronous reads (soil_capabilities()$limits$max_sync_observations) is read with soil_export().

Usage

soil_summary(
  soil = soil_session(),
  datasets = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  geometry = "any",
  layer = "all",
  view = "raw",
  profile_type = NULL,
  components = NULL,
  min_cumulative_percent = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes ("wosis_points", "wise_profiles", "soter_profiles", "soter_polygons", "sotwis_polygons", "sotwis_components", "sotwis_estimates", see soil_datasets()); NULL (the API default) selects every dataset, usually above the limit of synchronous reads. API field datasets.

variables

Source codes ("ORGC", "CLAY") or canonical property keys ("organic_carbon"), see soil_variables(); NULL returns every variable. With variables the column set is fixed by the request, so every page has the same columns. API field variables.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees (longitude, latitude). API field bbox.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names, case-insensitive (the API resolves them). API field country.

geometry

"any", "point" (profiles) or "polygon" (map units). API field geometry.

layer

"all" horizons, or "first": the first horizon(s) of each profile with first_layer_status and profile_markings (see soil_first_layer()). API field layer.

view

"raw": the ISRIC mirror as stored (sent explicitly); "revised": the decided rules of the revised view applied by the API in the response (see soil_revised_rules()). API field view.

profile_type

Profiles by the source's own type term: "synthetic" (KENSOTER), "virtual" (Upper Tana), "none" (no type in the source record), all selecting or all excluded with a "!" prefix (c("!synthetic", "!virtual")); NULL keeps every profile. API field profile_type.

components

Components of multi-component map units (SOTWIS, SOTER polygons): NULL (the API default, "representative"), "representative" (largest proportion_percent), "all", or "cumulative" (by decreasing proportion until min_cumulative_percent). API field components.

min_cumulative_percent

Threshold of components = "cumulative", 0 to 100 (required with it, refused without it). API field min_cumulative_percent.

Value

A soil_summary list:

  • datasets (character), geometry;

  • feature_count, horizon_count, observation_count, observed_feature_count (features with at least one horizon row) and each <count>_by_dataset (named double; with one dataset its total);

  • avg_horizons_per_feature (horizon rows per observed feature) and avg_horizons_per_feature_by_dataset;

  • by_dataset: a data frame of the same counts, one row per dataset;

  • variables (source codes, character), variables_by_dataset (named list of character), variable_semantics (data frame dataset, source_code, canonical_property_key, canonical_name, property_family, source_unit, procedure_code, procedure_description, source_value_kind, mapping_status, documentation_url, source_notes);

  • formats (export formats), warnings;

  • view, revised (with view = "revised": the rules applied with their counts, see soil_revised_rules()), components and min_cumulative_percent (when a component dataset is selected);

  • metadata (see soil_metadata()): the request, its id, versions and the catalog rows of the datasets for soil_citations().

Printing shows a short report: counts per dataset, the variables, the warnings and the revised rules.

Details

The arguments are the selection of soil_observations(), validated the same way before any request and sent with the same API names.

Rights: soil:summary. Capabilities: canonical_summary; revised_view for view = "revised", profile_type_filter for profile_type, component_selection for components.

See also

soil_availability() for the counts by country and variable, soil_consistency() for the distinct totals of the daily statistics.

Other summaries: soil_availability(), soil_consistency()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
s <- soil_summary(soil, datasets = c("wosis_points", "wise_profiles"), country = "KEN")
s
s$observation_count_by_dataset
s$variable_semantics[, c("dataset", "source_code", "canonical_property_key")]
soil_citations(s)

# the revised view lists the rules it applies to the selection
soil_revised_rules(soil_summary(soil, datasets = "sotwis_polygons", view = "revised"))
} # }
